verdict.rationale: AI Gateway keeps a detailed, filterable request log in its observability dashboard, and the filtered list can be exported as CSV or JSON. That gives a manual way to move log data out. There is no evidence of automated export or trace delivery into an external observability stack. Missing for 10: trace export (e.g. OpenTelemetry), log drains or streaming integrations to third-party observability tools, programmatic/API-based log export, independent corroboration.
